title: FIGFLEX: A Mixed-Precision FP-INT GEMM Accelerator Co-Designed with Low-Bit LLM Quantization
abstract: arXiv:2610.30480v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Weight-only quantization keeps LLM activations in floating point and stores weights as low-bit integers, turning the dominant workload into floating-point-integer (FP-INT) general matrix multiplication. Recent quantizers reach a 2-3-bit average with mixed precision, but hardware has not kept pace: GPUs dequantize weights to FP16 before the tensor-core multiply-accumulate, and bit-parallel FP-INT accelerators run at a single weight precision, so fewer bits save memory but not computation. In this paper, we present FIGFLEX, an algorithm-hardware co-designed mixed-precision accelerator whose bit-parallel datapath scales throughput as precision falls. FIGFLEX contributes (1) a shift-add, radix-4 reformulation of FP-INT multiplication that fuses the multiply-accumulate into a unified, precision-flexible partial-product reduction and roughly halves the partial products, together with a novel INT3 optimization that reclaims the idle datapath

translated_title: FIGFLEX：与低比特LLM量化协同设计的混合精度FP-INT矩阵乘加速器
translated_abstract: 仅权重量化方法将大语言模型（LLM）的激活值保持为浮点数，并将权重存储为低比特整数，使得主要计算负载转变为浮点-整数（FP-INT）通用矩阵乘法。尽管最新的量化器通过混合精度达到了平均2-3比特的水平，但硬件发展并未跟上步伐：GPU在张量核执行乘累加运算之前需将权重反量化为FP16，而位并行的FP-INT加速器只能运行在单一权重精度下，因此更少的比特数只节省了内存而未能节省计算。在本文中，我们提出了FIGFLEX，这是一种算法-硬件协同设计的混合精度加速器，其位并行数据通路的吞吐量可随精度降低而扩展。FIGFLEX的贡献包括：（1）对FP-INT乘法的一种移位加法、基-4（radix-4）重新表述，将乘累加融合到统一的、精度灵活的部分积归约中，并将部分积数量大约减半；同时提出了一种新颖的INT3优化方法，以回收空闲的数据通路资源。
tldr: FIGFLEX是一种算法-硬件协同设计的混合精度FP-INT矩阵乘加速器，通过移位加法基-4乘法重构将部分积减半，使数据通路吞吐量随权重精度降低而扩展，从而让低比特LLM量化真正转化为计算性能的提升。
